jobs.description:
Location: Amarillo, TX - Pantex Plant

Job Title: IT Senior Endpoint Engineer - Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) & Intune

Career Level From: Senior Associate

Career Level To: Senior Specialist

Organization: End User Computing (51130473)

Job Specialty: System Administration

What You'll Do

As a hands-on technical specialist, you will serve as the enterprise owner for endpoint management across Windows devices. Your primary responsibility will be the design, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and Microsoft Intune, along with the Azure/Entra ID services that keep Intune resilient and secure. You will drive patch/update compliance, application and Operating System (OS) deployments, client health, and co‑management strategy Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM + Intune), while closely collaborating with Cybersecurity, Network, and Support teams to ensure reliability, security, and compliance of our endpoint fleet. You are responsible for maintaining a thorough knowledge of applicable Federal, State, Department of Energy (DOE), Corporate and Plant rules, regulations, and Plant-wide operating policies and procedures.

Essential Job Duties

Microsoft Core Infrastructure (MCM) Platform Ownership & Optimization

Own, administer, and continually optimize MCM core infrastructure (site server, Management Point (MP)/Distribution Point (DP) roles, Structured Query Language (SQL), Windows Server Update Services (WSUS)/Software Update Point (SUP), boundary groups, content distribution, and backup/disaster recovery (DR) `readiness).Drive client‑health improvement using telemetry, automation, and consistent collection hygiene.Enhance platform performance and scalability across multiple locations and networks.

OS Deployment (OSD) Engineering

Lead design, maintenance, and modernization of OSD task sequences for Windows 11.Engineer efficient driver‑lifecycle management, secure imaging standards, pre‑provisioning (BitLocker), post‑install hardening, and automation to reduce build time and increase reliability.Evaluate migration from traditional OSD to Autopilot‑first strategies where appropriate.

Software Packaging & Deployment

Establish packaging standards and best practices for Microsoft Installer (MSI)/Executable File (EXE)/Win32 deployments across MECM and Intune.Build, test, and deploy applications at scale; optimize distribution‑point content placement and success‑rate visibility.Expand capabilities using third‑party patch/catalog solutions to increase coverage.

Patch & Update Compliance

Lead monthly update cycles for Windows OS, Microsoft 365 Apps, and third‑party applications.Rapidly remediate non‑compliant devices through automation and targeted deployments.Ensure WSUS/SUP synchronization health and maintain a reliable update pipeline.

Intune & Modern Device Management

Own Intune configuration strategy, including Autopilot, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and Windows Update for Business rings.Implement and maintain Endpoint Security Baselines (BitLocker, Defender, firewall, attack surface reduction, Credential Guard).Drive clarity and evolution of MECM/Intune workload split using co‑management and Tenant Attach.

Identity & Security Integration

Manage Entra ID (Azure AD) device identity, Conditional Access policies, role‑based access control, and SCEP/NDES/PKI integrations.Ensure secure enrollment, compliance signaling, and alignment with cybersecurity requirements.

Automation, Monitoring & Troubleshooting

Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph Application Programming Interface (API), Kusto Query Language (KQL) (Log Analytics/Azure Monitor), and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)/Power Business Intelligence (BI) reporting to automate operations and improve visibility.Troubleshoot complex endpoint failures (Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI), Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS), policy conflict, client registration, SUP sync, Cloud Management Gateway (CMG) connectivity) and deliver long‑term fixes.

Documentation & Leadership

Create and maintain enterprise runbooks, engineering standards, and troubleshooting guides.Lead technical workshops, mentor peers, and contribute to continuous improvement of endpoint management processes.

Minimum Job Requirements

Bachelor's degree in engineering/science/information technology discipline: Minimum 2 years of relevant experience.OR Master's degree in engineering/science/information technology discipline.OR applicants without a bachelor's degree may be considered based on a combination of at least 10 years of completed education and/or relevant experience.

Department of Energy (DOE) Order 426.2A Requirements

Not applicable.

Preferred Job Requirements

Expert‑level experience with MCM administration, OSD engineering, software distribution, client health, and update compliance.Strong experience with Intune, Autopilot, configuration profiles, compliance/policy management, and Windows security baselines.Deep PowerShell scripting capability, operational analytics knowledge (Log Analytics/KQL, SSRS, Power BI).Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex Windows/MECM/Intune issues at scale.Experience with CMG, Tenant Attach, and defining MECM/Intune co‑management workloads.Experience optimizing MECM SQL performance and WSUS/SUP maintenance.Work with Secure Communications Interoperability (SCUP) or third‑party patching solutions.Relevant Microsoft certifications (MD‑102, SC‑300, AZ‑104, AZ‑500) or equivalent hands‑on proficiency.

Description
Leidos is seeking an experienced M365 Security and Compliance Administrator to join our Information Technology team. This role requires a seasoned professional who can strategically manage and enhance the security and compliance posture of the M365 environment within a GCC (Government Community Cloud) tenant, particularly in a federal agency context. jobs.description:
SciTec, a wholly owned subsidiary of Firefly Aerospace, is a dynamic non-traditional defense contractor that delivers advanced technologies in support of U.S. National Security and Defense. For the past forty-five plus years, we have supported Department of Defense customers by developing innovative remote sensing algorithms, tools, and techniques to deliver world-class data exploitation capabilities supporting missile defense; intelligence, surveillance, & reconnaissance; space domain awareness; and aircraft survivability missions.

Important Notice: SciTec exclusively works on U.S. government contracts that require U.S. citizenship for all employees. SciTec cannot sponsor or assume sponsorship of employee work visas of any type. Further, U.S. citizenship is a requirement to obtain and keep a security clearance. Applicants that do not meet these requirements will not be considered.

SciTec is seeking a Systems Engineer with a specialization in human factors and software user experience to support the Ground‑Based Radar Digitization (GBRD) modernization program. This role centers on the systems engineering of operator‑facing interfaces—ensuring mission users can clearly understand radar system state, data flow, alerts, and operational context. You will translate mission and stakeholder needs into system requirements, define UI workflows, manage interface specifications, and guide integration of display components into the modernized architecture.

You will collaborate with radar‑processing teams, MBSE modelers, UI/UX designers, backend developers, mission operators, and government stakeholders to deliver clear, actionable, intuitive user displays.

Responsibilities

jobs.description:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Federal Platform Engineer to support the deployment, operation, and sustainment of Keeper solutions across U.S. Government environments, including IL5, IL6, and classified networks. This is a 100% remote position with travel as needed.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help deliver secure, reliable, and compliant platform operations for mission-critical federal environments.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of federal IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices, and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, including FedRAMP High and GovRAMP Moderate Authorization, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why federal agencies, including NASA and the DOJ, trust Keeper to defend against today’s sophisticated adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com .

About the Role

The Senior Federal Platform Engineer will be responsible for the hands-on delivery, deployment, automation, and sustainment of Keeper solutions in high-security U.S. Government environments. This role combines DevOps, platform engineering, release engineering, and site reliability responsibilities, with a strong focus on restricted and controlled environments. You will build and maintain deployment pipelines, automate infrastructure, support release and cutover activities, troubleshoot production issues, and help ensure systems remain secure, reliable, and audit-ready across IL5, IL6, and classified deployments. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in environments where change control is strict, access is limited, and operational rigor is critical.

Responsibilities

- Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows for federal environments

- Support software releases, deployment execution, cutovers, validation, rollback planning, and post-release monitoring across IL5, IL6, and classified networks

- Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or similar infrastructure-as-code tools

- Maintain hardened infrastructure, configuration baselines, patching processes, and operational controls for restricted environments

- Troubleshoot complex deployment, infrastructure, application, and platform issues in coordination with Engineering and Security teams

- Build and maintain logging, monitoring, alerting, and operational telemetry to improve system visibility and reliability

- Support incident response, recovery, postmortems, and corrective actions for federal platform environments

- Partner with Engineering, QA, Security, and Product teams to improve deployment readiness, operability, and release quality

- Maintain runbooks, deployment documentation, operational procedures, and configuration records for federal systems

- Support continuous monitoring, audit readiness, and authorization activities by producing required technical evidence and artifacts

- Assist with vulnerability remediation, security hardening, compliance drift detection, and system configuration validation

- Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms to improve automation, troubleshooting, documentation, scripting, and operational efficiency

Requirements

- 7+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, Release Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or a related technical role

- Hands-on experience deploying and operating systems in IL5, IL6, FedRAMP High, classified, or similarly restricted government environments

- Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, release automation, deployment workflows, and production change management

- Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or similar

- Experience with AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government

- Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages

- Strong understanding of secure configuration, patching, logging, access control, and operational hardening practices

- Experience with observability, including logs, metrics, alerting, and production troubleshooting

- Familiarity with federal security and compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, RMF, DoD Cloud Computing SRG, and related operational controls

- Experience working in environments with strict change control, limited access, and formal release processes

- Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose issues across infrastructure, applications, networking, and deployment pipelines

- Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to support scripting, automation, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational analysis

- Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Keeper is FedRAMP authorized; therefore all applicants must be a U.S. Person

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting IL6 or classified deployments

- Experience operating Kubernetes or containerized workloads in high-compliance environments

- Experience with DISA STIGs, CIS benchmarks, or automated security hardening

- Familiarity with secrets management, PAM, IAM, or zero-trust architectures

- Experience supporting continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, or audit evidence collection

- Experience working directly with government agencies, primes, integrators, or mission partners

Benefits

- Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)

- Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life

- Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance

- 401K (Roth/Traditional)

- A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

- Above market annual bonuses

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

- Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter

- Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility

- Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

- Interview notes, assessments, communications

- Scheduling information

Information From Others:

- Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile

- References (with your consent, before final offer)

- Public professional profiles

- Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

- We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

- Assess your application and suitability

- Manage interviews and recruitment workflow

- Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)

- Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

- Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)

- Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)

- Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required

4. Who We Share Information With

Internal:

- HR, hiring managers, interviewers*, IT support for system administration

*Note - diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers.

Third Parties:

Service providers who assist with:

- Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers

- Background verification vendors (post offer)

- Recruitment agencies (where applicable)

- Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

- You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)

- You're hired (transfers to employee records)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

- Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements

- Object to or restrict processing

- Withdraw consent (where applicable)

- Request data portability

- Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

9. Automated Decisions

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.

10. Contact - Candidates can send privacy questions to: privacy@keepersecurity.com

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

WHAT IS AIS?
Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers’ most pressing national security requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:
The Anduril Intelligence Systems System Administrator ensures the smooth functioning of the core underpinnings of the information system under management. This position provides direct onsite customer support:

- Install, configure, and maintain network, computer, and software systems.

- Manage user accounts, system permissions, and policies to ensure compliance with customer policies.

- Support new hardware selection, acquisition, installation, and configuration.

- Perform regular backup operations and exercise disaster recovery procedures.

- Maintain technical documentation of system configurations, changes, and procedures.

- Contribute to development and deployment of system scripts and tools to automate routine tasks to enhance system efficiency.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience maintaining and upgrading physical hardware (e.g. workstations, servers, laptops, network switches) in classified IT systems.

- Strong understanding of system updating for both Windows and Linux operating systems.

- Prior installation and administration of Linux (e.g. RedHat, CentOS, Debian, etc. ).

- Administration of Windows servers and workstations, including Active Directory and Group Policy management.

- Knowledge and experience of scripting languages (e.g. Powershell and Bash).

- Hands-on experience with virtualization platforms: VMWare, KVM, Hyper-V.

- Ability to work collaboratively and independently to address customer problems.

- Must work five days a week onsite at a customer site located in Northern Virginia.

- Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret SCI security clearance with Full Scope Polygraph

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience providing system administrator support to classified IT systems

- Significant experience in maintaining/upgrading system hardware and startup/shutdown of rack components.

- Experience applying OS updates, anti-virus/anti-spyware updates, and Application updates in a classified environment.

- Ability to locate user session data via the command line.

- Experience with a scripting language (Bash, Python, etc.) to automate and solve reoccurring tasks

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to provide direct customer support.

US Salary Range

$112,000 - $149,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Endpoint Protections
jobs.summary: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500,...
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Elastic Security Endpoint Protections team builds the visibility, prevention, and on-device machine learning capabilities at the core of Elastic Defend, our endpoint and SIEM security solution. We work in kernel and user mode across Windows, macOS, and Linux, against adversaries who study how to defeat what we build. Our work reaches the security community as well as the product, through original research and conference talks. We are looking for a Senior Manager who has done this work personally and can still review a design or write code. You will lead a globally distributed team and set the tone for a group that values candid feedback, collaborative learning, and mentorship.

We believe security is a team sport, and our efficacy is independently verified rather than simply claimed: in recent third-party enterprise protection testing, Elastic Security earned a perfect malware protection score with zero false alarms, the top result in the field. If you are energized by leading world-class engineers and making a measurable dent in how the industry defends the endpoint, we would love to hear from you!

What You Will Be Doing

- Lead, mentor, and grow a world-class engineering team. Guide senior research engineers across endpoint internals, prevention engineering, and machine learning. Coach career development, deliver candid feedback, own the hiring pipeline, and set new engineers up to contribute quickly.

- Own the roadmap and drive delivery. Decide where to invest in new visibility and where to deepen existing protection engines, balancing efficacy, performance, and stability across millions of endpoints. Work with product managers to define requirements and land high-quality features on release timelines.

- Connect your team's work to the rest of Elastic Security. Every event source your team adds unlocks new detection and protection capabilities across the product. Invest in the joint planning, working relationships, and shared accountability that get your team's work into customers' hands.

- Direct the team's machine learning work. Set direction on model development, training data quality, and the telemetry features those models depend on, and connect that work to the broader machine learning strategy across Elastic Security.

- Drive cross-platform protection parity. Bring the depth Elastic has on Windows to macOS and Linux, keep the team ahead of new hardware architectures, and sustain the platform vendor relationships that give you early access to emerging operating system security APIs.

- Represent the team externally. Support your engineers in presenting at conferences and publishing on Elastic Security Labs, engage with customers and partners on protection capabilities, and be a credible voice for Elastic in the endpoint security community.

What You Bring

- People-leadership experience managing senior technical individual contributors on a globally distributed team. You lead with curiosity rather than authority, actively solicit feedback, and have a track record of growing people, not just shipping releases.

- You have been a practitioner. Substantial hands-on experience as a security researcher before moving into leadership: analyzing attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), building the protections that counter them, and shipping into software that runs on customer machines at scale.

- Operating system internals knowledge , in both kernel and user mode, earned hands-on rather than through oversight, and deep enough to reason about undocumented behavior and challenge a design on its technical merits. Windows depth is what we need most, with macOS or Linux close behind.

- Hands-on reverse engineering and malware analysis experience. You have done this work yourself, and can still read a disassembly, assess a research finding on its merits, and judge which threats warrant investment.

- An adversarial instinct. You anticipate how a protection will be evaded before it ships, and hold the team to designing for resilience rather than for the proof of concept in front of them.

- Clear communication skills , comfortable writing for technical and executive audiences and distilling deeply technical work for non-expert stakeholders.

- Motivation to thrive in a distributed, autonomous environment , with a genuine passion for protecting customers from real-world adversaries.

- Demonstrated experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate feature development, debug complex systems, and optimize existing codebases.

- You possess the ability to comfortably rotate across projects, collaborate across functions and teams, and seamlessly adapt to evolving team structures.

Bonus Points

- Prior ownership of an EDR, EPP, or other endpoint security product.

- Personal research output: published vulnerabilities, patents, in-depth technical writing, or conference talks.

- Experience leading machine learning engineers working on security problems.

- Experience partnering with product engineering teams to take research prototypes through to GA release.

- Conference speaking experience (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON, CODE BLUE, Virus Bulletin).

- Familiarity with the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) and Elastic Security.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

- Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

- Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

- Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

- Generous number of vacation days each year

- Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

- Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

- Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co . We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster; Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision Poster; Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster and Know Your Rights (Poster)

If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - *IL, KS, & TX.

Company Information

At Bit By Bit, we’ve been helping organizations thrive since 1987. Originally founded as a database application development and networking company, we’ve grown into a full-service IT firm and a recognized leader in delivering reliable, cost-effective managed IT services across the Tri-State area.

Our team specializes in building and managing solutions that solve critical business challenges. Beyond technology, our culture is rooted in humility and curiosity, and our vision is simple: to help untangle people and process challenges so businesses can move forward with confidence.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Windows Systems Engineer / Administrator to support and administer enterprise Microsoft infrastructure across Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure, and virtualized environments.

This is a senior technical role responsible for the ongoing administration, maintenance, troubleshooting, lifecycle management, and improvement of critical server and cloud infrastructure. The role also requires the ability to provide technical guidance and coordinate the work of a small team of highly technical engineers and administrators when needed.

Requirements

Duties and Responsibilities

Windows Server Administration

Administer, maintain, and support Windows Server environments, including Windows Server 2012 R2, 2016, 2019, 2022, and 2025. Manage the full Windows Server operating system lifecycle, including installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and decommissioning. Support both physical and virtual Windows Server environments. Monitor server health, performance, capacity, and availability and proactively address infrastructure issues. Troubleshoot complex Windows Server incidents and identify appropriate corrective and preventative actions. Plan and execute server upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and infrastructure changes.

Active Directory & Core Microsoft Infrastructure

Administer and support enterprise Active Directory environments, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory). Manage users, groups, permissions, organizational units, authentication, and other Active Directory services. Administer and troubleshoot Group Policy (GPO), DNS, DHCP, Windows File Systems, and Print Servers. Support hybrid identity environments and integration between on-premises Active Directory and Microsoft cloud services. Troubleshoot authentication, access, replication, policy, and other Active Directory-related issues.

Microsoft 365 & Exchange

Administer and support Microsoft 365 environments. Manage Microsoft Exchange and Exchange Online administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance. Support Microsoft 365 users, licensing, permissions, mailboxes, groups, and related services. Troubleshoot complex Microsoft 365 and Exchange issues and coordinate resolution of service-impacting incidents. Support Microsoft 365 and Exchange migrations, upgrades, and configuration changes as required.

Microsoft Azure

Administer and support Microsoft Azure environments. Manage Azure-based infrastructure and services related to Windows Server and Microsoft enterprise environments. Support identity, access, security, configuration, and integration between Azure and on-premises systems. Troubleshoot Azure infrastructure and connectivity issues.

Virtualization

Administer Windows Server nodes within virtualized environments. Manage and support Microsoft Hyper-V environments. Support VMware environments as required. Assist with or lead migrations from VMware to Microsoft Hyper-V where applicable. Troubleshoot virtual machine, host, storage, resource, and performance-related issues.

Additional Systems Administration

Configure, administer, and troubleshoot Microsoft IIS. Configure and administer SFTP environments and services. Support Windows file systems, permissions, storage, and related infrastructure. Participate in infrastructure upgrades, migrations, deployments, and technical projects. Apply security, patching, and system-management standards across supported infrastructure.

Technical Leadership & Service Delivery

Provide senior-level technical support and guidance for complex infrastructure issues. Assist and mentor engineers and administrators in troubleshooting and systems administration. Coordinate technical activities across a small team when required. Prioritize competing incidents, service requests, maintenance activities, and project requirements. Work collaboratively with technical teams and other stakeholders to resolve infrastructure issues. Maintain accurate technical documentation, system configurations, procedures, and change records. Follow established change-management, security, and operational procedures. Use ServiceNow or other service-management platforms to manage incidents, requests, changes, and technical work.

Minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience supporting Windows Server environments, including operating system installation, configuration, performance tuning, patching, upgrades, troubleshooting, and decommissioning. Advanced experience administering Windows Server environments across physical and virtual infrastructure. Strong experience administering Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID/Azure Active Directory. Advanced Microsoft 365 and Exchange/Exchange Online administration experience. Strong Microsoft Azure administration experience. Hands-on experience with Group Policy (GPO), DNS, DHCP, Print Servers, and Windows File Systems. Experience configuring and administering IIS. Experience with SFTP setup and administration. Strong virtualization experience, particularly Microsoft Hyper-V. Experience administering VMware environments. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities. Demonstrated ability to manage complex technical issues through resolution. Experience providing technical direction or coordinating the work of engineers and administrators.

Professional Capabilities

Strong time-management, prioritization, and multitasking skills. Ability to think critically, analytically, and strategically. Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical problems. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong attention to documentation, security, operational standards, and change management. Ability to collaborate effectively within a technical team and across functional areas.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Master’s degree in a relevant field is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in a ServiceNow environment. Experience migrating VMware infrastructure to Microsoft Hyper-V. Experience supporting hybrid Microsoft environments combining on-premises infrastructure with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365. Previous experience leading or managing a small team of highly technical engineers or systems administrators. Relevant Microsoft, Azure, VMware, or other infrastructure certifications are considered an asset. Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

jobs.description:
Job Description
We offer a competitive salary for this role, with an expected range of $70,600 to $89,400. The final offer will depend on your experience, skills, and overall qualifications. General Dynamics – Bath Iron Works also provides a variety of benefits including medical & dental insurance coverage, 401(k) retirement savings plan, flexible spending accounts/HSAs, life and disability insurance, company paid holidays, paid time off (PTO), health coaching, athletic trainers, employee assistance programs and onsite health services.

As part of the Endpoint Engineer team, the Endpoint Engineer III builds, administers, and maintains the client endpoint and mobile environment for Bath Iron Works under the direction of the Sr. Endpoint Engineer. The role executes established build standards and images, administers enterprise endpoint management tooling and mobile device management (MDM), develops PowerShell automation for defined tasks, and implements endpoint security configurations.

The Endpoint Engineer III serves as an L3 escalation point for the desktop and mobility technicians on documented complex issues and partners with the Infrastructure, Security, and Service Desk teams on project execution. Operating under the BIW Business Operating System (BOS), the Endpoint Engineer III ensures compliance with safety, quality, and performance standards while coordinating with other key stakeholders to meet overall milestones.

Key Responsibilities

Safety Leadership:

Comply with all BIW safety and security standards while working across office, manufacturing, and shipboard environments.
Implement endpoint configurations that uphold BIW security and data-protection requirements, and follow established procedures when handling hardware, media, and sensitive data.

Project Execution:

Build and maintain client device images and standard build configurations for laptops, desktops, and mobile devices under the direction of the senior Endpoint Engineer.
Administer enterprise endpoint management tooling (e.g., MCM) and MDM platforms for software deployment, patching, compliance reporting, and mobile device policy execution.
Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate defined deployment, update, and endpoint administration tasks.
Implement endpoint security configurations in alignment with BIW security policy, including antivirus, encryption, patching, and vulnerability remediation activities.
Support endpoint lifecycle management activity, including hardware refresh execution and operating system upgrades across the estate.
Other duties as assigned.

Training and Development:

Maintain and document working knowledge of endpoint platforms, management tools, and security practices. Pursue and obtain relevant certifications.
Provide L3 guidance to the desktop and mobility technicians on documented issue types and grow technical depth under the mentorship of the senior Endpoint Engineer.

Team Collaboration and Communication:

Serve as L3 escalation for documented complex hardware, operating system, and application issues raised by Desktop Technician II; escalate architecture-level or undocumented issues to the senior Endpoint Engineer.
Partner with the Infrastructure, Security, and Service Desk teams on assigned project execution and cross-team incident resolution.
Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to technicians, peer IT teams, and stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement:

Identify opportunities to automate manual processes encountered during routine work and propose them for prioritization with the senior Endpoint Engineer.
Contribute to technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles for endpoint tooling and procedures.

Required/Preferred Education/Training
Required:

High school diploma or equivalent.

Preferred:

Associate or bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Microsoft endpoint/Windows certifications (e.g., MD-102 Endpoint Administrator) and other relevant industry certifications.

Required/Preferred Experience
Required:

Must be able to satisfy BIW background-check and site-access requirements.
2–4 years of endpoint administration, senior desktop, or entry-level endpoint engineering experience in an enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience administering an enterprise endpoint management platform (e.g., MCM), including image build, software deployment, patching, and compliance reporting.
Working proficiency in PowerShell for endpoint automation, and working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, and identity management.
Working understanding of core networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN) and endpoint security concepts (encryption, MFA, patching, and vulnerability remediation).

Preferred:

Exposure to cloud-based endpoint management (Intune/Autopilot) and Entra ID, MDM administration, ServiceNow, Jira, and experience in a defense, manufacturing, or other regulated environment.

Job Description

Role: End User Compute Engineer

Location: Hybrid, Lakeville, MN (3 days onsite)

Duration: 1 year

Rate: $35/hour W2

Position Summary

We are seeking an End User Compute Engineer to provide hands-on technical support and endpoint management for a growing enterprise environment. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical issues, delivering exceptional customer experiences, and serving as a trusted technology partner across the organization.

You will support a broad range of end-user technologies, including desktops, laptops, mobile devices, collaboration platforms, and conference room technologies. In addition to day-to-day support, you'll play an important role in improving endpoint management, patching strategies, conference room reliability, and overall user productivity.

This opportunity offers a mix of technical troubleshooting, executive support, endpoint administration, cross-functional collaboration, and process improvement, making it an excellent fit for someone who enjoys both operational support and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

End User Support & Issue Resolution

Resolve technical issues from a prioritized support queue, ensuring timely and professional service.
Troubleshoot complex hardware, software, networking, and end-user computing issues across Windows, macOS, mobile devices, printers, phones, and peripherals.
Provide support for both onsite and remote employees while maintaining a consistent user experience across locations.
Deliver high-touch support to senior leaders and key stakeholders when required.
Communicate clearly with users, provide status updates, and ensure issues are fully resolved.

Collaboration & Meeting Technology Support

Support, maintain, and troubleshoot conference room technologies, including Microsoft Teams Rooms, video conferencing systems, digital displays, projectors, and related AV equipment.
Ensure meeting rooms are operational, reliable, and ready for business-critical meetings.
Assist with deployment and optimization of collaboration technologies across multiple sites.

Endpoint Administration & Device Management

Configure, deploy, secure, and support endpoint devices in accordance with enterprise standards.
Utilize endpoint management platforms such as Intune, ManageEngine, or similar tools to manage devices and software.
Support endpoint security initiatives, including BitLocker, multi-factor authentication, single sign-on technologies, and compliance requirements.
Develop and enhance endpoint patching and software deployment processes to improve reliability and reduce risk.

IT Operations & Cross-Functional Partnership

Collaborate with infrastructure, security, application, and productivity teams to resolve complex technical issues.
Support enterprise technology initiatives, including software rollouts, system upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
Manage and prioritize requests through the IT service management platform.
Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures.

Continuous Improvement

Identify recurring issues, analyze trends, and recommend long-term solutions.
Conduct proactive system checks and preventative maintenance activities.
Help improve support processes, workflows, and user experiences across the organization.
Provide training, guidance, and knowledge sharing to end users and junior support staff.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in IT support, desktop engineering, endpoint management, or a similar end-user computing role.
Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows environments, Microsoft 365 applications, mobile devices, hardware, peripherals, and collaboration technologies.
Experience supporting enterprise endpoint technologies, including device configuration, deployment, patching, and lifecycle management.
Experience administering and supporting:

Windows Enterprise environments
Active Directory
Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, Office applications)
Group Policy
BitLocker
Single Sign-On (SSO)
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

Experience with IT ticketing and service management platforms such as ServiceNow or similar tools.
Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues independently.
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to lift up to 45 pounds when supporting endpoint and conference room equipment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting Microsoft Teams Rooms, conference room technologies, and audio-visual systems.
Experience providing executive or white-glove support to senior leadership.
Familiarity with endpoint management tools such as Intune, ManageEngine, or Lansweeper.
Basic PowerShell scripting experience for automation and administration tasks.
ITIL certification or practical knowledge of ITIL service management principles.
Experience supporting hybrid work environments and remote employees.
Familiarity with compliance, security audits, or regulated environments.
Experience independently leading small endpoint management or user technology improvement projects.

Technical Environment

Candidates can expect to work with technologies including:

Windows Enterprise
Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, Office Suite)
Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR)
Active Directory
Intune
ManageEngine
Lansweeper
ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms
BitLocker
MFA and Single Sign-On technologies
Group Policy
Mobile device management tools
Printers, VoIP phones, and enterprise peripherals
PowerShell
Video conferencing and audio-visual systems

What Success Looks Like

Successful individuals in this role are highly customer-focused and take ownership of issues from initial contact through resolution. They combine strong technical troubleshooting skills with professionalism, empathy, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.

You will thrive if you:

Enjoy solving complex technology problems in fast-paced environments.
Build trust through clear communication and follow-through.
Can balance urgent support needs with long-term process improvements.
Work effectively across multiple IT teams and business groups.
Take a proactive approach to identifying risks and preventing issues before they impact users.
Are comfortable supporting everyone from frontline employees to executive leadership.
Continuously seek opportunities to improve technology, processes, and the overall user experience.

Why Join This Opportunity

Play a visible role supporting critical business users and technology solutions.
Work with a broad range of modern endpoint, collaboration, and workplace technologies.
Gain exposure to enterprise-scale IT operations and cross-functional initiatives.
Help shape endpoint management, patching, and support processes that directly impact employee productivity.
Enjoy a varied role that combines hands-on technical support, project work, collaboration technologies, and continuous improvement efforts.
Join a team that values service excellence, operational reliability, and technology innovation.

Travel: Less than 5%

Additional Expectations: Occasional after-hours support and on-call responsibilities as needed.

Benefits + Perks

Comprehensive Benefit Plan

Hollstadt offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, paid sick leave, and retirement benefits to eligible employees. With three different medical plans to choose from, you can enroll in the coverage you need from individual to family, or anywhere in between!

Remarketing Process

Hollstadt is based on retention and relationships. We get to know your strengths and career wishes throughout your assignment and then start remarket discussions 6-8 weeks prior to your end date. By being proactive, we are able to keep your down time between assignments as short as possible, unless you choose otherwise.

Professional Development

Hollstadt offers on-demand training through our consultant portal. Trainings give our consultants the continuing education they need to excel on their projects. Many of our courses apply towards continuing education credits and we have an entire training hub dedicated to upskilling in Artificial Intelligence (AI).

401k + Matching

One popular benefit is our 401(k) match on the first 4% of your contributions. Hollstadt wants to help you reach your long-term financial goals and understands that planning for your future is critical. Consultants also have access to support from a Financial Advisor.

Bonus Opportunities

We appreciate and reward loyalty. Join Hollstadt, stay for 5 years, and we’ll give you a $5,000 Longevity Award bonus! Additionally, we know great talent knows other great talent. If you are on contract with Hollstadt and refer one of your connections who gets placed, we’ll pay you $1,000!

Ongoing Support & Networking

We have made a significant investment in building a support program for our consultant team - so you never have to feel like you are going it alone. We also have a Consultant Coach program which acts like a 'work buddy' to provide a safe ear for questions or concerns at your client site.

If you have extensive experience administering Microsoft enterprise technologies and enjoy solving complex technical challenges while leading modernization efforts, we'd love to speak with you.

Manage and support MEMCM (SCCM), Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, and Citrix VDI

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Who we are:
Farm Credit Bank of Texas is a $42.2 billion wholesale bank that has been financing agriculture and rural America for over 100 years. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we provide funding and services to rural lending associations in five states, and we are active in the nation's capital markets.
While you may not be familiar with our name, Farm Credit Bank of Texas plays a critical role in supporting the businesses that make it possible for America to maintain access to an affordable and safe food supply, an industry which is one of the most innovative and evolving of our time. And while you help us deliver on our mission, we deliver on our commitment to you as a valued employee by providing competitive compensation, generous health and wellness benefits packages and an attractive workplace located along the bluffs of the Colorado River just minutes west of downtown Austin.
We seek out top talent in their fields, whether it be technology, finance, accounting, credit, human resources, or other administrative functions, and welcome you to join us in our mission to feed the world.
Position Description:
The End-User Computing Engineer is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and securing the Bank's End-User Computing (EUC) environment. This role serves as a technical resource for the implementation, management, optimization, and troubleshooting of enterprise desktop technologies, virtual desktop infrastructure, endpoint management platforms, and related end-user services.
Working as part of the Information Technology team, the End-User Computing Engineer collaborates closely with Customer Support, Infrastructure Services, Information Security, and other technology teams to maintain reliable, secure, and efficient EUC services. The role provides advanced technical expertise, third-tier support, and engineering solutions that improve system performance, strengthen security, and enhance the overall user experience.
The position focuses on ensuring the availability, scalability, and security of the Bank's endpoint computing environment through proactive administration, automation, and continuous improvement. The End-User Computing Engineer leverages technical expertise to support modern workplace technologies, streamline operations, and deliver solutions that align with the Bank's business objectives and technology strategy.
Operating with a high degree of ownership and accountability, the End-User Computing Engineer identifies improvement opportunities, resolves complex technical issues, implements technology enhancements, and helps ensure that employees have secure and reliable access to the systems and tools they need to perform their work effectively.
Day-to-Day Duties and Responsibilities:
* Monitor and maintain enterprise EUC services to ensure acceptable levels of performance, reliability, and availability.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting, problem resolution, and preventative maintenance for desktop, endpoint, and virtual desktop technologies.
* Provide third-tier technical support and technical guidance to Customer Support and other IT teams.
* Administer and support desktop operating systems, endpoint management platforms, mobile devices, and related technologies.
* Enhance system security through endpoint hardening, vulnerability remediation, configuration management, and security-focused engineering practices.
* Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, standards, procedures, and operational support materials.
* Create and maintain automation solutions and scripts that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and optimize operational processes.
* Manage assigned EUC systems and services, ensuring consistent performance, support, maintenance, and lifecycle management.
* Track work requests, operational activities, incidents, and project tasks through the Bank's IT service management processes.
* Communicate infrastructure updates, maintenance activities, and technology changes to management, support teams, and end users as appropriate.
* Support operating system and application deployment, patching, packaging, and update management activities.
* Collaborate with Information Security, Infrastructure Services, and application teams to support technology initiatives, compliance requirements, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Participate in the evaluation, testing, and implementation of new technologies that improve the employee computing experience and support the Bank's strategic objectives.
What You Bring to the Team:
Our ideal candidate has experience supporting enterprise end-user computing environments and enjoys working in a collaborative, customer-focused technology organization dedicated to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
This role requires a combination of endpoint engineering, systems administration, automation, troubleshooting, and customer service expertise, including:
* Associate's degree, technical school certification, or equivalent technical experience.
* Professional certifications in Microsoft, Omnissa, VMware, or related technologies preferred.
* Three (3) or more years of experience as a Systems Administrator, Systems Engineer, End-User Computing Engineer, or similar technology role.
* Equivalent combinations of education, certifications, and experience may be considered.
* Experience administering enterprise Windows environments, desktop platforms, and endpoint management solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex technical issues.
* Experience supporting desktop operating systems, mobile devices, endpoint security, and end-user productivity tools.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of service, accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively collaborating across cross-functional technology teams.
* Commitment to operational excellence, continuous learning, and delivering high-quality technical support and engineering solutions.
Preferred:
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting, automation, and systems management tools.
* Experience supporting virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), including Omnissa Horizon, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop environments.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and automated platform management.
* Experience with endpoint security technologies, vulnerability management, and remediation programs.
* Experience supporting Windows 11, Microsoft 365 applications, and modern workplace technologies.
* Experience with Windows Autopilot, device provisioning, and modern desktop deployment methodologies.
* Experience administering cloud-based computing environments, including Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) monitoring solutions such as ControlUp.
* Experience supporting collaboration and conferencing technologies including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Cisco Webex, and related platforms.
* Experience working within regulated financial services, banking, or highly controlled technology environments.
Why Farm Credit Bank of Texas:
In addition to a competitive salary, we offer comprehensive, affordable, and competitive benefit options that are focused on health and wellness, financial security, and achieving a work-life balance:
* Flexible health-and-wellness benefits, including medical insurance, prescription drug coverage, dental insurance, vision care, flexible spending accounts, and more.
* 401(k) plan that includes immediate vesting of a generous employer match and additional employer contribution.
* Long-term disability and life insurance.
* Vacation leave, sick leave, and paid holidays.
* Fertility benefit and parental leave plan.
* Up to two days per year to volunteer in local community organizations, services, or events.
* Ongoing professional-development opportunities.
* Generous tuition-reimbursement program.
* Physical fitness incentive plan.
* Employer matching gifts program.
Important note: We care about your hiring process and take it seriously. A real person will review your applications, meaning response timelines may vary. The interviewing process at Farm Credit Bank of Texas may include phone calls and emails, on-site interviews, and requests for portfolios or demonstrations of work. We can't personally follow up with each applicant, and we will do our best to create a professional, respectful, and thorough process for candidates with whom we identify as a potential fit.

jobs.summary: Mission Objectif du poste : L’architecte Cloud & Digital Workplace chez Microsoft est chargé de définir, de concevoir et de piloter la mise en oeuvre de solutions cloud et d’environnement de travail d’entreprise sur Microsoft Azure et Microsoft 365. Ce...
jobs.description:
Mission

Objectif du poste : L’architecte Cloud & Digital Workplace chez Microsoft est chargé de définir, de concevoir et de piloter la mise en oeuvre de solutions cloud et d’environnement de travail d’entreprise sur Microsoft Azure et Microsoft 365. Ce poste de direction stratégique et technique combine des compétences en architecture cloud, en environnement de travail moderne, en sécurité, en gestion des identités, en collaboration et en infrastructure afin de fournir des services numériques sécurisés, évolutifs, résilients et centrés sur l’utilisateur.

L’architecte dirige le comité cloud, qui fait office d’instance d’approbation pour l’adoption et le déploiement de nouveaux services cloud au sein du groupe.

Principales responsabilités

Stratégie et architecture cloud

• Définir et maintenir la stratégie et la feuille de route d’entreprise relatives au cloud Microsoft.

• Concevoir des architectures cloud sécurisées, évolutives, hautement disponibles et rentables.

• S’assurer que les solutions cloud sont en adéquation avec les objectifs métier, les exigences de sécurité et les normes de conformité.

• Mettre en place des « Azure Landing Zones » et des modèles de gouvernance du cloud.

Architecture de l’environnement de travail numérique

• Définir la vision et l’architecture de l’environnement de travail numérique.

• Concevoir des plateformes de collaboration et de productivité à l’aide de Microsoft 365.

• Diriger les initiatives de transformation de l’environnement de travail favorisant le travail hybride et à distance.

• Améliorer la productivité des collaborateurs et leur expérience numérique grâce à des services innovants liés à l’environnement de travail.

Identité, sécurité et conformité

• Concevoir la gestion des identités et des accès de l’entreprise à l’aide de Microsoft Entra ID.

• Définir et mettre en oeuvre une sécurité « Zero Trust » Principes de sécurité.

• Concevoir des solutions d’accès conditionnel, de gouvernance des identités, d’authentification multifactorielle (MFA) et de gestion des accès privilégiés.

• Mettre en place des contrôles de sécurité maîtrisant : la suite Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, la prévention des pertes de données (DLP) et la protection des informations.

Garantir la conformité aux réglementations du secteur et aux politiques d’entreprise.

Gestion des terminaux et des appareils

• Définir une stratégie moderne de gestion des terminaux.

• Diriger l’initiative Microsoft Intune.

• Mettre en oeuvre : Windows Autopilot, la gestion des appareils mobiles (MDM), la gestion des applications mobiles (MAM), la sécurité des terminaux et les politiques de conformité des appareils

Leadership technique

• Agir en tant qu’autorité technique senior pour les technologies cloud et d’environnement de travail.

• Diriger les comités d’examen de l’architecture et les comités de gouvernance technique.

• Définir les normes d’ingénierie et les meilleures pratiques.

• Servir de point de relais pour les problèmes techniques critiques.

Votre profil

Qualifications et compétences

• Plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans les infrastructures informatiques, le cloud et les services liés à l’environnement de travail.

• Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans la conception de solutions cloud Azure.

• Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans l’architecture d’environnements Microsoft 365 d’entreprise.

• Expérience avérée dans la direction de programmes de transformation numérique et de migration vers le cloud.

• Expérience dans la gestion de plateformes cloud et d’environnement de travail à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

• Solide expérience en matière de sécurité, de conformité et de gestion des identités.

Compétences techniques requises

• Technologies cloud : Microsoft Azure, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Networking, AKS, Azure Virtual Desktop, AzureSurveillance, Azure Backup & Recovery, gouvernance Azure, gestion des coûts Azure.

• Microsoft 365 : Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, OneDrive Entreprise, Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform.

• Sécurité et identité : Microsoft Entra ID, accès conditionnel, gestion des identités privilégiées (PIM), Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, architecture Zero Trust

• Gestion des terminaux : Microsoft Intune, Windows 11, Autopilot, Endpoint Analytics, gestion des appareils mobiles

• Automatisation et DevOps : PowerShell, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Power Automate, API Microsoft Graph

Certifications souhaitées :

Microsoft Certified : Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Microsoft 365 Certified : Enterprise Administrator Expert

Microsoft Certified : Cybersecurity Architect Expert

Microsoft Certified : Identity and Access Administrator Associate

Microsoft Certified : DevOps Engineer Expert

Microsoft Certified : Power Platform Solution Architect Expert.

WHAT IS BOX?Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.
By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It ‘ s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more.

Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHAT YOU’LL DOThe Senior IT Platform & Identity Engineer will join a global team comprised of the most talented IT professionals in the industry. Box IT is looking for an exceptional candidate to support our IT Platform & Identity team across client endpoint management systems and various SaaS solutions, while also supporting our IAM ecosystem. As an IT Platform & Identity Engineer, you will work on a variety of different systems and software to maintain our corporate endpoint and mobile device ecosystem, support our Identity and Access Management strategy (IAMs), and build new integrations across various cloud services that support day-to-day operations for IT and Security. To succeed in this fast-paced, challenging position you will need to be a highly motivated problem solver, focused on frictionless outcomes in support of the best possible end user experience, and deeply passionate about all things IT.
Architect, build, operate, and optimize core IT systems across a variety of different software stacks and platforms in order to support the IT platform environment. This includes Windows, macOS, and SaaS applications (Okta, Duo, Box, Google Workspace, Splunk Cloud, JIRA, ServiceDesk, Confluence and more).

Develop and maintain documentation for systems and architectural standards.

Administer client platform management tools and frameworks. We use Kandji, Intune, Active Directory Entra & ADE, and continuously explore other solutions.

Manage and administer a mixed platform environment (macOS, iOS, Android & Windows) using the above client system management tools.

Develop and manage client administration tools/processes.

Streamline, implement, and iterate on current provisioning solutions.

Design and scale monitoring and alerting tools, in collaboration with other teams across IT.

Write modular, maintainable tooling in traditional and low-code systems such as Powershell, Python, Shell (zsh) and Okta Workflows, with a strong focus on automation to reduce repeated work and auto-remediation with low to no end-user involvement.

Regularly partner with the security team to ensure Box is a continued leader in the intelligent content management space.

Provide Tier III support and troubleshooting for complex issues escalated from the IT Support team.

Mentor more junior team members and provide direction and guidance when appropriate.

6 or more years experience in client platform across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android and/or 6 years of direct experience in Identity and Access Management.

Proven experience and track record troubleshooting complex macOS and Windows problems in an enterprise environment with a strong emphasis on security.

Knowledge of DHCP, DNS, Active Directory (and/or Entra ID), AD Group Policy.

Must have strong experience in IAM platforms such as Okta, Duo, PingFed, OneLogin, Entra ID, etc.

Experience with one or more programming languages relevant to scripting, automation, and interacting with APIs (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc).

Experience implementing and supporting IT applications and client platforms “at scale”.

Strong ability to interact with and understand complex technical requirements across all levels of the organization.

Working knowledge of essential security concepts.

Strong ability to analyze and solve complex business problems.

Strong ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally, including working with a geographically distributed team.

Strong organizational, planning, documentation skills & excellent attention to detail.

Box is a global enterprise with offices worldwide. Must be willing to occasionally adjust schedule to meet/work with team members in alternative timezones.
