Design and own the enterprise-wide collaboration strategy, aligning platform capabilities with business goals and workforce needs.

Serve as the product owner for Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, and related apps), Box, and Slack — managing roadmaps, feature rollouts, and lifecycle planning.

Evaluate emerging tools and features, making informed recommendations on adoption, consolidation, or retirement of platforms.

Partner with IT, HR, Legal, and business units to ensure collaboration tools meet compliance, security, and usability requirements.

Monitor platform usage, licensing, and capacity to optimize spend and inform strategic decisions.

Lead the organization's transition to a Cisco-based AV environment, serving as the primary business and technical liaison across stakeholders, vendors, and integrators throughout the implementation.

Manage AV service vendors and systems integrators, including contract oversight, performance management, and escalation resolution.

Lead the team responsible for monitoring usage, health, and capacity of the AV and video conferencing infrastructure across all locations.

Identify and champion opportunities to improve and enhance audio/video conferencing services, from room system standardization to user experience improvements.

Oversee the design, deployment, and ongoing optimization of conference room technology in collaboration with facilities and IT teams.

Establish and maintain AV service standards, runbooks, and escalation procedures to ensure consistent, high-quality meeting experiences.

Requirements

A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, or related degree is required.

7+ years of experience in IT, with a strong focus on collaboration platforms, digital workplace, or productivity technologies.

Demonstrated experience managing Microsoft 365 at an enterprise scale, including Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, and OneDrive.

Hands-on experience with Box and Slack in an enterprise environment, including administration, governance, and adoption programs.

Experience with enterprise AV environments, including conference room technology, video conferencing platforms, and AV/IT integration — Cisco Webex or Cisco room systems experience strongly preferred.

Proven track record managing external vendors, integrators, and service providers.

Experience developing internal communications, adoption campaigns, or product marketing content — the ability to "sell" technology to a non-technical audience is essential.

Strong project management skills with experience leading cross-functional initiatives.

Skills & Competencies

Strategic thinking — able to connect platform capabilities to broader business outcomes.

Executive communication — comfortable presenting to and influencing senior leadership.

Stakeholder management — skilled at navigating competing priorities across business units.

Vendor & contract management — experienced holding external partners accountable.

Data-driven decision making — uses adoption and usage metrics to guide strategy.

Servant leadership — leads teams with clarity, empathy, and accountability.

Customer-first mindset — treats internal users as customers whose experience matter.

Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements:

This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary.

Director, Enterprise Platform Engineering (Mac & Windows Endpoints)

This position serves as the senior leader accountable for the strategy, engineering, and operational excellence of our global Windows Endpoint ecosystem—physical devices (Windows 10/11), hardware, peripherals, virtual desktops (Azure Virtual Desktop), and the supporting management platforms (Intune, Autopilot, GPO modernization, endpoint security, and automation).

This leader will oversee a large engineering organization responsible for the full lifecycle of endpoint delivery for tens of thousands of devices. They will drive modernization, enterprise-scale efficiency, secure-by-default standards, and a best‑in‑class user experience. This role requires an exceptional blend of engineering breadth, strategy, transformational leadership, and operational rigor.

Core Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Vision

Define and execute the multi‑year strategy for the Windows endpoint physical and virtual ecosystem - HW, AVD, Intune, application delivery, automation, updates, and security posture.Serve as the enterprise authority on Windows client engineering, hardware, modern endpoint management, virtualization strategy, and platform modernization.Establish technology roadmaps for Windows 11, cloud‑managed device models, virtualization, and future workplace experience capabilities.Partner with senior engineering, security, compliance, risk, support, network, collaboration, procurement, and business stakeholders.

Engineering Ownership & Platform Excellence

Lead engineering teams responsible for: Windows 10/11 platform engineering Azure Virtual Desktop architecture & operations Intune / AutoPilot / Endpoint Manager governance & policy design Application packaging/delivery & automation Firmware/BIOS, hardware standards, driver lifecycle, and performance optimizationOversee zero‑touch provisioning, configuration baselines, CIS/SOX/PCI compliance enforcement, endpoint telemetry, and health & reliability engineering.Mature the platform‑as‑a‑product operating model—including roadmap, release management, KPIs, SLIs/SLOs, and user‑experience score improvements.

Operational Excellence

Ensure consistent global performance across tens of thousands of endpoints, meeting aggressive availability, reliability, and MTTR targets.Strengthen the L2/L3 engineering/operations partnership and reduce engineering RUN burden to 20k devices) with globally distributed teams.Strong command of enterprise operations, major incident management, and engineering KPI/OKR constructs.Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead through ambiguity, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Preferred skills:

Experience in regulated industries (financial services, insurance, healthcare).Modern Workplace & Microsoft certifications (MDM/Intune, Windows, Azure).Experience with Mac, mobile, or cross‑platform endpoint architecture.Familiarity with SCCM/ConfigMgr coexistence and cloud transition strategies.Special Factors

At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.

Requisition Number: 29236

This opportunity resides with Warfare Systems (WS), a business group within HII's Mission Technologies division. Warfare Systems comprises cyber and mission IT; electronic warfare; and C5ISR systems.

HII works within our nation's intelligence and cyber operations communities to defend our interests in cyberspace and anticipate emerging threats. Our capabilities in cybersecurity, network architecture, reverse engineering, software and hardware development uniquely enable us to support sensitive missions for the U.S. military and federal agency partners.

Leadership Mindset at HII - Mission Technologies

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes-regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People - Commit to learning and supporting team success. Build Relationships - Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust. Take Ownership - Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work. Customer First - Focus on the mission and those we serve. Shape the Future - Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement. Act with Urgency - Take initiative and follow through with purpose.
These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Job Description

HII's Mission Technologies division is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that advance national security and defense objectives. This position is part of our Cyber and Intelligence division, which plays a critical role in supporting Enterprise-Level Security and Modernization efforts across IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, physical facilities, and personnel operations.

We are searching for an Endpoint Systems Administrator candidate. The selected candidate will contribute to a high-impact government program focused on enhancing and securing mission-critical systems and environments. Due to the classified nature of the mission and the sensitivity of the operational environment, an active TS/SCI security clearance will be required. Candidate must be willing to obtain and maintain a CI poly.

Endpoint Systems Administrator I: $65,000 - $85,000

Endpoint Systems Administrator II: $80,000 - $105,000

Endpoint Systems Administrator III: $100,000 - $125,000

Essential Job Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and optimize standard operating system images for all enterprise endpoint devices. Own the full lifecycle of desktop OS platforms, including design, configuration, testing, release, documentation, and continuous improvement. Manage deployment, maintenance, and version control for major enterprise applications and core endpoint software suites. Lead the patch management process for operating systems, security updates, and application patches; ensure timely, compliant, and well-communicated release cycles. Evaluate and integrate new tools, technologies, and methods to improve endpoint stability, security, and performance. Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with security policies, vulnerability remediation, and hardening standards. Create and maintain technical documentation, configuration baselines, and operational procedures. Provide Tier 3 support for escalated endpoint issues requiring deep technical expertise. Monitor system performance, reliability, and patch compliance using enterprise management tools. Participate in strategic planning for endpoint technology architecture and long-term modernization efforts.

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of progressively responsible endpoint administration experience.

Demonstrated proficiency and expertise in the following:
- Deploying, configuring, and managing Windows or ThinLinux end-client operating system solutions.
- Installing, configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting Microsoft and third-party enterprise applications across large endpoint environments.
- Performing comprehensive operating system and application patching via MECM/SCCM, including researching updates, testing in controlled environments, deploying to production, troubleshooting failures, and executing rollback procedures when required.
- Applying, validating, and maintaining security configurations based on Security Requirements Guides (SRGs) and Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) for all supported endpoint platforms.
- Managing endpoint configuration, compliance, and automation through enterprise tools such as MECM/SCCM, Intune, or similar technologies.
- Diagnosing and resolving escalated endpoint issues requiring advanced technical knowledge of OS internals, application behavior, and configuration dependencies.
- Performing post-deployment remediation and cleanup patching using PowerShell or similar scripting tools to automate updates, enforce configuration baselines, and resolve inconsistent patch states.

TS/SCI clearance required with ability to obtain CI Poly

Must meet DoD 8140/CSWF for 451-Intermedediate or be willing to obtain the appropriate credential within 6 months

Preferred Requirements

Formal training or vendor certifications related to operating system administration or MECM/SCCM.
Experience automating endpoint management tasks using PowerShell or similar scripting tools.
Familiarity with modern endpoint management solutions such as Intune or Autopilot.

The listed salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. When extending an offer, HII's Mission Technologies division takes a variety of factors into consideration which include, but are not limited to, the role's function and a candidate's education or training, work experience, and key skills.

Meet HII's Mission Technologies Division
Our team of more than 7,000 professionals worldwide delivers all-domain expertise and advanced technologies in service of mission partners across the globe. Mission Technologies is leading the next evolution of national defense - the data evolution - by accelerating a breadth of national security solutions for government and commercial customers. Our capabilities range from C5ISR, AI and Big Data, cyber operations and synthetic training environments to fleet sustainment, environmental remediation and the largest family of unmanned underwater vehicles in every class. Find the role that's right for you. Apply today. We look forward to meeting you.

To learn more about Mission Technologies, click here for a short video: https://vimeo.com/732533072

HII is more than a job - it's an opportunity to build a new future. We offer competitive benefits such as best-in-class medical, dental and vision plan choices; wellness resources; employee assistance programs; Savings Plan Options (401(k)); financial planning tools, life insurance; employee discounts; paid holidays and paid time off; tuition reimbursement; as well as early childhood and post-secondary education scholarships. Bonus/other non-recurrent compensation is occasionally offered for qualified positions, and if applicable to this role will be addressed by the recruiter at the screening phase of application.

Why HII
We build the world's most powerful, survivable naval ships and defense technology solutions that safeguard our seas, sky, land, space and cyber. Our workforce includes skilled tradespeople; artificial intelligence, machine learning (AI/ML) experts; engineers; technologists; scientists; logistics experts; and business administration professionals.

Recognized as one of America's top large company employers, we are a values and ethics driven organization that puts people's safety and well-being first. Regardless of your role or where you serve, at HII, you'll find a supportive and welcoming environment, competitive benefits, and valuable educational and training programs for continual career growth at every stage of your career.

Together we are working to ensure a future where everyone can be free and thrive.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

Do You Need Assistance?
If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to buildyourcareer@hii-co.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Reasonable accommodations are considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address. Additionally, you may also call 1-844-849-8463 for assistance. Press #3 for HII Mission Technologies.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a sharp, trusted, and autonomous Federal Solutions Engineer to support NinjaOne’s expansion into the Public Sector. As an embedded technical partner to our Federal Growth team, you’ll play a critical role in both pre-sales strategy and post-sale onboarding, acting as a key translator between technical buyer needs and the broader Product and Engineering teams. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in mission-critical moments, loves navigating complex RFPs and government requirements, and can tailor messaging to both deep technical evaluators and high-level decision makers. You’ll serve as a customer advocate internally while building scalable tools, templates, and processes to support the next generation of federal growth.

Location - This is a Remote role open to candidates within Virginia or Maryland or those willing to relocate unassisted.

Travel Requirement - Up to 40% representing NinjaOne at key industry events, product launches, and customer engagements.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own the technical presales experience for Federal and SLED accounts, guiding customers through evaluation, demo, architecture design, and onboarding phases.

Deliver tailored product demos and technical deep dives that align with customer security standards, compliance needs (FedRAMP, DoD IL2/4/5), and procurement requirements.

Support and guide the implementation of the NinjaOne platform for new public sector customers—ensuring quick time-to-value and customer success.

Act as the technical translator between Sales and Product—surfacing actionable feedback and feature gaps that directly impact deal velocity or retention.

Assist with RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires, providing accurate, compliance-aligned technical responses that differentiate NinjaOne’s value.

Troubleshoot and resolve customer technical issues, including endpoint configuration, agent behavior, networking challenges, and integrations.

Collaborate with Engineering and Product Management on solution enhancements that improve the Federal customer experience.

Create and maintain reusable content and lab environments to scale future engagements (demos, battlecards, scripts, templates, etc.).

Represent NinjaOne at industry events, partner summits, and key government-facing conferences as a technical ambassador.

Technical Requirements

Proficiency with Windows environments (registry, services, performance troubleshooting).

Working knowledge of Linux and macOS systems and basic command-line troubleshooting.

Solid foundation in networking and security concepts, including firewalls, VPN, DNS, and common endpoint protections.

Familiarity with Active Directory, remote access tools, and endpoint deployment methodologies.

Hands-on experience with RMM tools, ITSM platforms, and endpoint lifecycle management is highly preferred.

Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and translate their value to customers.

Experience using Salesforce, Jira, Highspot, or equivalent systems is required.

About You

5+ years in a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Consultant role—within the Public Sector Enterprise space.

Exceptional communicator—capable of clearly articulating complex information to both technical and non-technical audiences, from system administrators to procurement and leadership.

A calm and credible presence in high-stakes, high-pressure customer conversations.

Customer-first mindset—you genuinely care about their experience and success.

Organized, self-directed, and capable of thriving in a remote-first, fast-paced environment.

Familiarity with FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels, and NIST frameworks is required.

You align with our values Curiosity, Integrity, Kindness, Humility, Builders and are committed to creating an environment where these values flourish in our teams.

Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required; respected technical certifications (e.g., Security+, MCSE, CISSP) is preferred.

Ability to obtain a security clearance is required.

About Us

NinjaOne automates the hardest parts of IT to deliver visibility, security, and control over all endpoints for more than 20,000 customers. The NinjaOne automated endpoint management platform is proven to increase productivity, reduce security risk, and lower costs for IT teams and managed service providers. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and provides free and unlimited onboarding, training, and support. NinjaOne is #1 on G2 in endpoint management, patch management, remote monitoring and management, and mobile device management.

What You’ll Love

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.

We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.

We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.

We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in Maryland, the base salary hiring range for this position is $140,000 to $140,000 per year with On Target Earnings of $200,000 to $200,000 per year.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment.

Our goal is simple: to make IT operations smarter, faster, and more resilient by ensuring the CMDB remains the backbone of enterprise service management.

Are you ready to lead transformative initiatives that strengthen our CMDB governance, accelerate discovery capabilities, and integrate cutting-edge tools? This role offers a unique opportunity to drive enterprise-wide impact through advanced technology solutions, including cloud and asset discovery and AI Agent experimentation designed to revolutionize IT operations.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior CMDB Infrastructure Engineer, , you will be the go-to expert for Tier 3 technical support and strategic implementation of the ServiceNow Discovery toolset. Your mission: ensure full enablement of discovery capabilities, capture critical assets and applications across global sites, and seamlessly integrate this intelligence into the CMDB—mapping interdependencies and relationships to deliver a single source of truth.

Key responsibilities include:

Lead Discovery & CMDB Integration: Implement and optimize ServiceNow Discovery to achieve comprehensive visibility of enterprise assets and applications.Drive Innovation: Pilot AI-driven solutions to automate and enhance CMDB governance and discovery processes.Solve Complex Challenges: Provide expert-level troubleshooting for critical production issues and ensure reliable system performance.Plan & Execute Enterprise Projects: Design and deliver major IT infrastructure initiatives, including new technologies and critical upgrades.Collaborate & Influence: Partner with IT teams and vendors to assess risks, resolve issues, and shape technical standards.Mentor & Elevate: Train and guide team members, sharing your expertise to build organizational capability.

Why This Role Matters

Your work will directly impact:

Operational Excellence: Strengthen CMDB governance and improve data accuracy to enable better decision-making.Future-Ready IT: Enable advanced discovery capabilities and AI-driven automation to position us for next-generation IT service management.Enterprise Resilience: Ensure robust, secure, and high-performing systems that support global business operations.

What We’re Looking For

Education & Experience: Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience, with 8+ years in technical specialties and 3–4 years in hardware/software configuration and troubleshooting.Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of infrastructure design, cloud engineering, networking protocols (TCP/IP, ACCP), performance tuning, debugging, and enterprise IT platforms.Certifications: Relevant technical certifications or ability to attain within 9 months.Skills That Set You Apart:Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.Excellent communication skills to influence and collaborate across teams.Proven ability to lead complex projects and mentor others.

Ready to Make an Impact?

Join us in shaping the future of IT operations. If you’re passionate about discovery, automation, and driving enterprise-wide transformation, this is your opportunity to lead.

Sponsorship

jobs.description:
Dexian has an immediate opportunity available for a detail-oriented and motivated Endpoint Administrator with MS Intune experience to manage, maintain, and optimize a unified endpoint management environment for our premier aerospace customer. The Endpoint Administrator will be the primary point of contact for the deployment, configuration, compliance, and security of all corporate-owned and BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) endpoints. Utilizing the Microsoft 365 stack-specifically Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID-you will ensure seamless, secure hardware and software lifecycles across Windows and iOS platforms.

A typical workday may consist of the following duties as directed by the client:

Policy & Profile Management: Build, test, and deploy Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines to standardize client environments.
Application Packaging & Deployment: Package, test, and distribute internal and third-party software updates, web links, and store apps across the enterprise.
Modern Provisioning: Administer and monitor modern device deployment systems, such as Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager, ensuring a zero-touch or minimal-touch provisioning pipeline for new hires.
Identity & Access Control: Collaborate with identity teams to manage device registration, primary user changes, group memberships, and targeted Conditional Access enforcement.
Troubleshooting & Escalations: Act as the Tier 2/3 escalation point for device enrollment failures, application installation blocks, and profile synchronization issues.
Reporting & Governance: Monitor Intune reporting dashboards daily to identify non-compliant devices, update patch status deficiencies, and remediate systemic configuration drift.
Documentation: Maintain clear, concise documentation outlining deployment processes, app packaging standards, and device lifecycle flows.

REQUIREMENTS AND SKILLS:
To be successful in this role, you should possess the following skills:

Security Stack Exposure: Familiarity integrating Intune with security tools like Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or implementing data protection via MAM (Mobile Application Management) without full device enrollment.
Problem-Solving & Analytical Rigor: A structured, logical approach to debugging deployment failures, policy conflicts, and log file analysis.
Cross-Functional Communication: The ability to explain technical enrollment steps or security restrictions clearly and empathetically to non-technical business professionals.
Adaptability: Curiosity and willingness to stay current with Microsoft's continuous cloud release notes, feature changes, and best-practice evolutions.
JAMF experience, desired

To be eligible for this position, you must meet or exceed each of the following:

Experience: 6-8 years of progressive experience in IT systems administration, with a minimum of 2-3 years dedicated specifically to managing and deploying policies within Microsoft Intune (Cloud-only or Hybrid/co-management configurations).

jobs.description:
## **Job Description:**
The Endpoint Administrator administers, configures, and maintains the University's endpoint computing environment, ensuring reliable, secure, and effective operation of end-user devices and related management platforms.
The position applies standardized practices and professional judgment to administer endpoint technologies, troubleshoot complex issues, and recommend improvements to configurations, processes, and tools used across the University.
Its primary responsibility is the configuration, administration, and ongoing optimization of endpoint management platforms and related system behavior.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
1\. Endpoint Administration and Lifecycle Management (35%)
- Administer the configuration, deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of Apple and Windows endpoint systems across academic, administrative, and shared computing environments.
- Apply standard images, configuration baselines, and management policies to ensure consistency, security, and operational reliability of endpoint devices.
- Coordinate with vendors and internal partners regarding supported hardware standards, warranty issues, and replacement planning.
- Participate in planned endpoint deployments and refresh activities, providing technical oversight and troubleshooting for complex issues.
2\. Endpoint Management Tools and Configuration ( 25%)
- Manage specific applications crucial for end-user computing, such as Microsoft Configuration Manager/System Center, Intune, and Windows Autopilot.
- Configure, maintain, and optimize endpoint management platforms, including deployment profiles, policies, application packages, and update mechanisms.
- Independently analyze endpoint behavior, deployment outcomes, and configuration issues to resolve problems and improve reliability and performance.
3\. Advanced Technical Support and Issue Resolution (15%)
- Serve as an escalation resource for complex endpoint-related issues that require in-depth technical analysis and systems-level troubleshooting.
- Provide targeted technical assistance for non-routine issues.
- Document resolutions, configurations, and known issues to support consistent administration and future problem resolution.
4\. Inventory and Endpoint Standards Compliance (15%)
- Maintain accurate endpoint inventory records and ensure devices comply with established configuration, asset, and lifecycle standards.
- Apply defined standards and procedures related to endpoint administration and technology refresh cycles.
5\. Endpoint Security and Configuration Compliance (10%)
- Maintain currency with issues related to virus and malware prevention, protection, and recovery.
- Apply approved security configurations, patching standards, and compliance controls to endpoint systems in coordination with Information Security guidance.
- Identify configuration risks or recurring issues and recommend corrective actions within established security frameworks.
## **Requirements:**
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
- Professional experience (approximately 2-4 years) administering endpoint or desktop systems in a managed environment
- Proficient technical knowledge of macOS, Windows, MS Office, and enterprise endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Configuration Manager, Intune, and Windows Autopilot
- Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve non-routine endpoint issues using professional judgment rather than scripted procedures
- Ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities and manage multiple concurrent technical tasks
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in a higher education or enterprise computing environment
- Familiarity with endpoint configuration standards, deployment tools, or automation
- Understanding of basic networking, authentication, and device security concepts
Working Conditions and Physical Requirements
- Standard office and campus environment; movement between campus locations as needed
- Ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and handle light to medium weights (up to 35 pounds).
- Role primarily involves systems administration and analytical work with limited physical handling of equipment
- May require occasional evening or weekend work tied to deployments or maintenance windows
## **Additional Information:**
Expected Hiring Range: $54,800 to $60,250
**Pay Transparency Disclosure:**
The compensation for this position will be determined based on factors that include available budget, internal equity, and the selected candidate's qualifications, experience, education, and other job-related credentials. This range represents Clark University's good-faith estimate of the expected hiring range at the time of posting consistent with Clark's compensation philosophy and internal alignment.
At Clark University we believe that diversity of experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to a more innovative and productive work environment. We welcome and encourage individuals of all backgrounds to join our team and contribute their unique ideas to help us achieve our goals.
Clark University offers a generous benefit package for full and, if applicable, part-time employees that include; paid time off, generous retirement plan, group health and dental insurance, life insurance, and tuition, along with use of many campus amenities. For a complete list of benefits for eligible employees visit [here](https://www.clarku.edu/human-resources/benefits/).
To review the Clark University Police Department Annual Security and Fire Safety Report visit [here](https://www.clarku.edu/offices/university-police/annual-security-and-fire-safety-report/).
## **Application Instructions:**
To be considered for this position, you must submit your credentials online. Create a **Clark University Careers** Account by clicking on the **APPLY NOW** button below. You will be able to upload the following documents, which are required for consideration:
- Resume

See the [FAQ](https://support.interviewexchange.com/articles/#!candidate/your-career-account) for using our online system. Please contact us if you need assistance applying through this website.
Already have a Clark University Careers Account? [Login to your account](https://clarku.interviewexchange.com/login.jsp) to add documents or update your account.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location Pension / Retirement benefits Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a member of IT Enterprise Architecture Data & Corp Tech team, the Lead Infrastructure Test Engineer – Endpoint Testing & Automation will lead the design, execution, automation, and continuous improvement of enterprise endpoint and servers validation for accelerated patch and application release cycles. this role is accountable for enabling ETE certification within a short testing SLA after deployment and release. The role will drive automated functional, regression, standard application, and performance testing using Login VSI and custom automation frameworks while ensuring measurable quality gates, actionable defect triage, and leadership-ready reporting across Laptop, VDI, VM, Windows laptop, VDI server and macOS environments.

The Enterprise Infrastructure End-to-End Testing (ETE) function validates endpoint readiness, stability, user experience, application functionality, and performance across VDI, Azure Persistent VM, Windows laptop, and macOS platforms following monthly patches, security updates, application upgrades, and emergency releases. The team partners with DWS Stakeholders to deliver rapid, evidence-based certification of enterprise endpoints while reducing user-impact risk.

Your Primary Responsibilities

Own and lead enterprise ETE endpoint and VDI assets validation across VDI, vPod, Windows laptops, VDI servers, and macOS following OS patches, security updates, application/agent upgrades, and business releases. Deliver accelerated testing SLAs \ by defining prioritized execution models, entry/exit criteria, automation runbooks, and rapid defect triage workflows. Provide fast, evidence-based release certification including pass/fail status, defect classification, risk assessment, and go/no-go recommendations in collaboration with DWS stakeholders. Drive unified functional, regression, and performance validation using standardized ETE test cases and Login VSI workloads to benchmark user experience, application response, and capacity impact. Design, build, and scale automation frameworks leveraging Python, PowerShell, APIs, and command-line tooling to automate endpoint validation, health checks, application testing, telemetry capture, and evidence generation. Standardize performance and experience validation by tracking CPU, memory, disk, logon time, application response, and Login VSI deltas against baseline metrics. Develop cross-platform validation workflows, including macOS testing for patch readiness, compliance, authentication, application behavior, security agent compatibility, and performance baselining. Perform deep OS and application troubleshooting across Windows environments, including event logs, services, drivers, kernel/CPU scheduling, memory/disk performance, network stack behavior, login delays, and endpoint agent conflicts.Leverage observability platforms (e.g., SysTrack, Login VSI, Event Viewer, PerfMon) to accelerate defect identification, root cause analysis, and impact quantification. Operate patch-cycle command center execution with defined ownership, severity models, escalation paths, and structured communication cadence for compressed release timelines. Establish automation-first, repeatable test execution models to increase coverage, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and eliminate false positives. Identify and escalate critical defects early with actionable telemetry, reproducible evidence, impact scope, and remediation ownership. Deliver leadership-ready reporting and dashboards covering SLA adherence, automation coverage, pass/fail trends, performance impact, defect aging, and enterprise risk exposure Continuously improve the ETE testing ecosystem by driving automation maturity, proactive risk detection, standardized execution, and measurable quality improvements. Ensure audit-ready compliance and control adherence, maintaining documented validation evidence, patch readiness metrics, and vulnerability remediation alignment.

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

Minimum of 6+ years of relevant experience Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience

Talents Needed For Success

8–12+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, endpoint testing, endpoint management, VDI operations, EUC engineering, QA automation, or enterprise technology operations. Hands-on experience validating enterprise endpoints including Windows laptops, VDI, vPod, and macOS devices after patching, application upgrades, security agent updates, and platform changes. Strong Windows operating system troubleshooting knowledge including logs, services, drivers, kernel/CPU behavior, memory/disk performance, networking, profiles, login experience, and endpoint agent interactions. Experience performing functional, regression, application, compatibility, and performance testing using standardized test cases and enterprise testing tools. Hands-on experience with Login VSI or comparable user-experience/performance testing toolsets for virtual desktop or application performance validation. Strong automation experience with Python, with working knowledge of C#, C++, PowerShell, REST/API integration, and command-line automation for endpoint validation and evidence collection. Working knowledge of SCCM/MECM and/or Microsoft Intune patch deployment processes, endpoint readiness models, and post-deployment validation workflows. Basic-to-intermediate application troubleshooting skills, including application launch, functional validation, crash/hang review, dependency validation, and performance symptom analysis. Experience with observability or DEX platforms such as SysTrack/Lakeside, endpoint telemetry, Windows Event Viewer, PerfMon, WMI/CIM, and log analytics is preferred. Mac endpoint validation experience including macOS patching, application validation, security tool compatibility, compliance posture, authentication/login flows, and performance checks is preferred. Ability to lead engineers, assign ownership, coordinate with cross-functional teams, manage priorities during compressed release windows, and produce executive-ready status reporting. Experience working in regulated enterprise environments with documented change validation, risk controls, audit evidence, and ITIL-aligned operational practices is preferred.

Preferred

Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 Cloud PC, Citrix DaaS, hybrid endpoint environments, and cloud-managed endpoint platforms. Exposure to endpoint security and productivity agents such as CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Qualys, Defender, SysTrack, Sapience, Cisco Secure Client, and similar enterprise agents. Experience building dashboards or automated reporting for SLA compliance, patch readiness, automation execution, defect trends, and performance regression analysis. Familiarity with AI-assisted or autonomous testing concepts, test orchestration, and continuous improvement of enterprise regression testing platforms.

Travelers is seeking a Technology Operations Engineer I to join our organization as we grow and transform our Enterprise Technology Solutions organization. Our Technology Operations Engineers help ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of critical systems through a combination of software engineering and infrastructure expertise. Technology Operations Engineers are responsible for building and maintaining automated solutions to manage system availability, incident response, monitoring, and capacity planning. These roles will collaborate closely with development teams, product owners, infrastructure, and operations teams to implement best practices and technical solutions to drive continuous improvement in service health while reducing operational toil and increasing deployment velocity.

jobs.description:
AllSector Technology is growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, motivated IT professionals to join our team as Level 1 or Level 2 MSP Engineers.

This is not a role where you will spend every day doing the same repetitive tasks. As an L1/L2 Engineer, you will be at the heart of our client operations, providing comprehensive support that blends remote help desk calls with scheduled on-site client assistance. Beyond daily support, you will have the opportunity to directly assist senior engineers with complex client project implementations, gaining valuable real-world experience across a wide range of industries.

We provide an environment designed for growth. You will gain hands-on exposure to the latest IT platforms and technologies, including modern Microsoft Cloud solutions, advanced cybersecurity tools, and emerging automation/AI platforms (like Rewst.io and Copilot).

We are seeking individuals who are passionate about technology, genuinely enjoy problem-solving, and are committed to learning new things every day. While you will be part of a collaborative team, the ideal candidate must also possess the judgment and accountability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.

Responsibilities

Experience with device provisioning and lifecycle management (Intune, Autopilot).

Strong documentation practices and a collaborative mindset.
